notes.title: Update Notes for 22 April 2025
notes.notes:
Graphics: An option to have the trees cleared around the runway and taxiways was added. This is an aesthetic choice for the player and does not affect gameplay.
Sound: Modified Pilot speech for cargo and maintenance aircraft.
Statistics: The elapsed time for aircraft now stops counting once aircraft reach the runway, which is the time at which their service rating is determined.

notes.title: Update Notes for 14 Mar 2025
notes.notes:
Executives: Added possibility to hire a Chief Finance Officer (CFO), Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), Chief Strategy Officer (CSO), and Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Executives bring certain perks to the administration of your airport, such as better contract rates, better ratings, more sales income, lower upgrade costs, and more efficient carbon balance. However, the extent to which executives serve these purposes depends on their individual skill levels, which can be seen upon hiring. Players are able to choose between staff and negotiate salaries. Players should be careful not to offer to low a salary as the number of executives in job market is limited and they may reject low offers.

 UI: Added an arrow button to the top-right corner of the selected object panel that allows closing the panel. The panel can still be closed with right-clicking or double-right-clicking.

notes.title: Update Notes for 3 Mar 2025
notes.notes: Languages: Added Brazilian Portuguese. Thanks to MaduJoga, Cezão Joga, and Erico Neto, for making this possible!

notes.title: Update Notes for 27 Feb 2025
notes.notes: Gameplay: Added option to use tugs with aprons such that aircraft can be turned around. This may allow the player to make more compact layouts at the cost of requiring more tugs.

notes.title: Update Notes for 9 Feb 2025
notes.notes:
Graphics: The giveway marker on a road at a taxiway crossing was replaced with an airplanes crossing sign.
 Graphics: Runway are now marked as L(eft), C(enter), or R(ight) when multiple runways with the same orientation are present. Background speech was updated accordingly as well as the small signs at the runway entrances.
 Graphics: Added the option to build concrete tiles around the airport. These do not affect gameplay, but are for those who prefer the look of concrete to grass.
 Graphics: When the follow selected object function is activated, the camera will continue to follow the object when the UI is hidden (which can be done by right-clicking).
 UI: Added the option to change the size of the menu icons.
 UI: Added option to bind a key to the Follow selected object function.
 Misc: Aircraft deceleration when landing is now calculated for different short exit distances such that aircraft have a smoother passage off the runway.

notes.title: Update Notes for 22 Jan 2025
notes.notes:
Gameplay: The game now checks to prevent buildings being placed too close to the runway or in the flight paths of aircraft. Fuel depots and fuel tanks will need to be placed slightly further from the runway. This change should add to realism, without increasing the learning curve too much. Old save games can still be loaded, even if they include buildings next to the runway.
 UI: Option to follow selected objects has been added (look for the target icon to the bottom-right of the inset view of the object).
 UI: Option to hide the UI has been added (right-click all the way out of the menus hide the UI)

notes.title: Update notes for 17 Jan 2025
notes.notes:
Follow-Me Cars now have flashing lights.
Added autosaves.

notes.title: Update Notes for 14 January 2025
notes.notes:
Gameplay: Added Short Exits Upgrade. Runway exits can now be placed at shorter distances for use by smaller aircraft, however, larger aircraft still require the full length of the runway.
 UI: Removed the decommission button in the detail panel for buildings to avoid confusion with a close window icon. Buildings can instead be decommissioned with the bulldozer tool.
 UI: Right-clicking now closes the Statistics and Fuel Menus. The icon to close these menus was changed to the back icon to be consistent with the menus.
 UI: Holding down middle mouse button and dragging will now zoom and rotate the camera.
 UI: Unpausing the game now returns the game to the last speed selected and not necessarily the normal speed.
 UI: Options to bind keys for speed control were added.
